title: The Projections of Paco
statement: The task is to find the unique integer p such that a token at 0, reflected about p and then about points a_1..a_n on a number line (x -> 2c - x), ends back at 0, with n up to 10^5. Each reflection is its own inverse, so undoing them in reverse from 0 lands at 2p; equivalently, p is the alternating sum a_1 - a_2 + a_3 - ...
